avis.texte: This is a horrible product. The product gets stuck in the cap and it doesn't remove mascara. It stings my eyes and dries quick on my skin, leaving a sticky feeling.

Honestly this cleanser did an amazing job at cleansing that wasn't the issue. It's that it made my skin feel extremely tight and actually broke me out because it pretty much dried my face out. But I do have super dry skin. I think it would be better for skin on the oilier side! It is great to get everything off but is just over stripping.

Purchased for my teen boy who had very mild break out but wanted soemthing to clear that area. This made his whole face break out a hindred times worse . We had to take him to a dermatologist. Its been months trying to reverse the damage , dont do it!

avis.titre: Definitely my new favorite daily face wash!
avis.texte: So gentle but cleans very well. Leaves me feeling fresh without the irritation

I really wanted to like this cleanser but I do not. It leaves my face feeling tight and itchy. It also doesn't feel like the product completely comes off after washing. It feels like it leaves a film behind no matter how much I rinse my face.

I like this cleanser. I did feel it got makeup off and didn't aggravate my sensitive skin and kept me from breaking out. The cons are that this is THICK and gloopy. It gets dried in the cap like toothpaste. At one point, I had to take the cap off and try to bang the product out to get it out. There are other cleansers that are mid range that I would rather spend money on.
It's an amazing product. You get a lot of out of it. Love it so much.

As an associate of a major cosmetic store, I've been very skeptical about Mario Badescu from the start. I recently spoke with a rep from the brand and she highly recommended this paried with the cleansing oil. I really really like it. Very gentle scent and didn't leave my skin feeling tight. Considering making this my daily cleanser for a while and I'm pretty picky when it comes to switching up my routine.

took me forever to find something i rlly like after aveeno calming line discontinued but finally found the products:) i have sensitive dry skin this prevents acne & doesnt dry out! i use this & the Mario Badescue Moisture Magnet with spf when i wake up & before i go to sleep it works great< 3

This is hands down one of the best facial cleansers I have ever used. It removes makeup so easily (I wear full makeup every day - primer, foundation, powder, etc.) without leaving skin feeling dry. It's unscented, which is nice. The bottle looks small initially but a little bit goes a long way.

To start, this product did a good job cleansing my skin. It lathered into a nice foam. It did not really have a scent to it, which is neither good nor bad. The price is nice, and you only need a small amount. That being said, this cleanser left my skin feeling uncomfortably dry and tight. I was disappointed with it.

I love this gentle foaming cleanser which I bought after reading of someone else using it, just in an aside. I have used MB products for years and am usually very satisfied. This one is wonderful - it IS gentle yet cleansing, foams easily - a little goes a long way. Skin is left soft and moist, not tight and dry. Highly recommend.
I have very sensitive skin and the is worked perfectly. I put it on after face wash, and made my face feel very clean. It cleared up bumps on my face the best I have every seen.

My skin was not normally very sensitive up until recently, when winter started. I decided to try this face wash when I was looking up more gentle washes (the only Mario Badescu product I've tried is a lip balm that I was gifted and love). I'm very happy with this cleanser! It's very gentle on my skin and I feel that it does a good job at cleaning.
so I was dealing with an allergic reaction and this made it even worse:(
I feel like it didn't take off all the product off my face. I have to do 2 washes to feel clean.

I love this cleanser. So, I got a terrible allergic reaction to a different cleanser where I was red, itchy , breaking out all over my face, including under my eyes, and my whole face was like that and in pain for a few days. until I found this cleanser and it calmed my skin down:)
This product is amazing! Would buy again, I have sensitive skin so it was definitely gentle.

I've been looking for a cleanser that isn't fragranced, successfully will remove my makeup in one wash, and makes a nice foam that removes the built up residue on my face from throughout the day (this is especially needed during the hot summer days in FL). The new Gentle Foaming Cleanser from Mario Badescu checks all of those boxes. My skin is glowing after just a few days of using it!! Love!
